title: ML Weft
description:
ML Weft is an open research program on adaptive models that change themselves within bounds that a program can check.

This archive is the source repository: the runtime (Plasm cells, invariants, the interaction-combinator VM, telemetry, the ledger simulator and gateway, Aywa), its tests, the design documents, and the sources and editions of the ML Weft papers.

Status: early research. Weft has no coin or token and nothing deployed to any blockchain.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
